scenes.text: Hello? HELLO?! The network is bad! Goodbye!
Good morning! Your bank account is LOCKED. Read me the six-digit code. You have thirty seconds.
And whisper it. Don't let anyone hear.
Okay. Whispering... This... is... Detective Rocco. Fraud Unit.
Hello? HELLO?! The network is bad!
I... I just called to say... have a nice day! Bye!
Banks never ask for your code. Never. Hang up.
